about_the_game:
The Last Sovereign began development in 2014, leading to the game being locked into a lower resolution. This art pack provides all scene art at the original resolution.

No content is locked in the main game and the DLC does not replace the artwork. This DLC exists purely for those who want to support development of the game and receive higher resolution art files in return. It includes the following:

  • 2074 images in original resolution (5+ GB)

  • 65 images from alternate or old versions of scenes (not used in the game)

  • Battle busts: 491 combat images + 527 uncropped files

  • All 38 custom portraits

Artwork will appear in an "Art Pack" folder in your base install folder. This work has been commissioned over years thanks to everyone's voluntary support, and your purchase of the DLC helps fund further artwork!

content_descriptors.notes: The DLC includes all of the major art assets from the base game, both SFW and NSFW.
